title: Normalize interrupted response bodies in JSON-first API requests
outcome: Parent-verified finding from authoritative reviewers 6460/6461, frozen trackedHeadDiffSha256 7853f694. ui/src/api-request.ts requestJsonFirst leaves response.text/json transport rejection unclassified, unlike request. In-memory diagnostic executed the actual TypeScript helper (transpiled without file output; only sanitizer stubbed): identical HTTP200 application/json errored ReadableStream yields ApiRequestError/status200/backendUnavailable=true from request, but raw TypeError/backendUnavailable=false from requestJsonFirst. Used by state/tail/history fetches. This sibling behavior predates the current save fix; it is incomplete error normalization, NOT proof snapshot retry stops: app-live-state-transport catch still schedules fallback retry for generic errors. Normalize transport/body failures consistently, retain HTTP status/cause, preserve malformed JSON and intentional cancellation semantics, and add regressions for JSON/text, known/unknown content length, 200/503/permanent4xx. No source edits in review. Searches requestJsonFirst, interrupted, response body and body-read found no existing item.
